passage_json.title: Passage - Audiobooks
passage_json.content: Audio books were first developed in the 18 seventies, right after Thomas Edison invented the recorder. A device that could record and play back sound people called these audiobooks talking stories at first. In great Britain, as early as 1878 someone recited part of a poem and recorded it. Marking an early try at audio content. At first, audiobooks weren't hot books. The recorder back then only had space to record about four minutes of sound, which was too short for full stories. In 1931a special project was begun to help blind people be able to read books by listening to them. This project was called the talking birds program. Many famous works were put in this project like Shakespeare's plays, making more people interested in them. In 1952 longer records called LPS came out. They could hold up to 45 minutes of recordings, allowing audio books to become longer. Later, cassette tapes became popular for listening to books. And then CDS were used. Today we use computers, laptops, and many other devices to enjoy audio books.There are millions of them now for every reader, from young kids just starting with theories to adults who love all kinds of books.

passage_json.title: Dialogue - Animated Film
passage_json.content:
W: Congratulations on your new animated film. What kind of story does the film tell?
M: It's about a young boy who was born with special powers. Because of this, people around are afraid of him. In the story, he learns who he really is and chooses to protect others instead of fighting them.
W: What is new or different about this film?
M: We wanted the film to look Chinese but also feel modern. The background designs were inspired by old Chinese ink paintings, but we used 3D animation for the characters. It was not easy to balance the two styles.
W: Can you tell us about the animation process?
M: First, we spent a long time writing and improving the story. Then we designed the characters and drew storyboards for every scene. After that, animators used computers to create movement. Sometimes 1 second of animation took several days to finish.
W: What was the biggest difficulty?
M: The hardest part was making decisions. Because every small change affected the whole film. And I often watched scenes late at night to check if they were good enough.
W: What do you hope audiences will remember?
M: I hope they remember the feeling. Animation is not only for fun. It can also help people think about courage, choice and being themselves.
W: That sounds very meaningful. Thank you for sharing your time and talking with us about your film.

passage_json.title: Dialogue - Jack's Roommate
passage_json.content:
W: Hey Jack, how's everything going?
M: Well, things are okay. Bob moved in last week. He's a nice guy from Britain and seems pretty easygoing.
W: That's good to hear.
M: Yeah, everything is fine so far except for some of his habits.
W: Oh, what's wrong with him?
M: Well, he stays up really late at night and sleeps until late morning. You know, I'm more of an early bird.
W: I guess it might take some time to get used to.
M: I doubt it. What's more, he's very messy. He leaves things all over the kitchen and the living room and sometimes I have to clean up after him.
W: Oh, come on, it can't be that bad.
M: It is on top of that. He's really loud when he talks on the phone with his friends and his music tastes are unusual. I never thought living with someone could be so challenging.
W: Sounds like it's going to be tough.
M: Yeah. I guess I just have to be patient and hope it gets better.

passage_json.title: Passage - Robots
passage_json.content: The idea of smart machines has a long history. In 1939, a large robot amazed people at the World's Fair. It led people to dream of a world full of smart devices. Today, the future is here. Modern robots do much more than just follow orders. They can recognize people's voices and climb stairs. They work in many fields. In factories, they can do daily tasks very well. They put together tiny parts and move heavy things. Some can even help doctors do operations in hospitals. What's more, robots do dangerous tasks to keep people safe. They are helpful to explore far into oceans or check damaged buildings after fires. According to some scientists, the most exciting robots are now active in space. For example, robots on the planet Mars act as scientists' eyes and hands. With cameras and tools, they study rocks and send useful information back to the Earth. While robots are becoming smarter, most experts agree they are designed to help us, not to take our place. The goal is to make the best use of this powerful technology to better serve us.

passage_json.title: Passage - City Marathon
passage_json.content: John decided to join in the city Marathon race. He bought himself comfortable sports clothes and nice training shoes. Then he trained hard for the race every day. However, on the day of the race he was very nervous. As soon as the race started, he ran so fast that he soon felt tired. Halfway through the race, John found it hard to keep up with the other runners. He steps grew heavier with each breath. He wanted to give up. Just as John began to slow down, he noticed a barefoot man running ahead of him. To his surprise, the man still looked relaxed. He seemed to be enjoying the race. Encouraged by the man John went all out and managed to get second place, just a little behind him. After the race, John found the man and said, "You were amazing. How did you run so well without shoes?" He replied, "I'm a pizza delivery man. Running all day is my job. This Marathon was a piece of cake." Hearing this John understood something important. Success doesn't only come from having the best equipment. What truly matters is to keep trying and find joy in the process.

passage_json.title: Passage - Magical Stories
passage_json.content: From old fairy tales to modern books like Harry Potter, people have always loved stories about magical beings like vampires and wizards. Many of us pretended to have magic powers when we were children. Even as we grow up, we still enjoy imagining what it would be like to be a superhero or a witch. So why are we so drawn to these magical stories? One big reason is that these stories make us feel a mix of fear and excitement. When a character is threatened by a monster, our hearts beat faster. But we can enjoy this feeling, because we know we are safe. Our brain understands that the story is not true, so we can enjoy being scared without any real danger. Also, these stories are a great way to take a break from everyday life. When we read them, we can forget about homework and other problems for a while. We get so interested in the characters' adventures that we feel like we are in a different world ourselves. In conclusion, stories about supernatural beings have all the right ingredients to keep us reading. They are exciting, a little scary, and offer a fun tour into amazing new worlds. That's an adventure we can safely enjoy from our favorite chair.

passage_json.title: Passage - Aibi Robot
passage_json.content: Do you ever have trouble falling asleep the night before a trip? Do you feel bad about leaving your pet alone at home? Now, with the help of Aibi, a smart robot, you don't have to worry about them at all, no matter how far away you are. The robot looks very cute. It is white and about eighteen centimeters tall, which is perfect for going through narrow places in your home. The robot only works when you control it with an app on your phone, so you can decide exactly when to check on your pets. It has some advanced equipment, all of which work together to keep you connected to your furry friends. Once you connect it to your phone, you can see what the robot sees right on your screen with the help of a smart camera, getting a clear look at their funny daily moments. It can go around your home easily, so you can check on your pets, talk to them in real time, and play with them. The robot can also store food for a few days at a time with a small and tidy pocket on its back, so you can feed your pets while you are not at home. As you can see, the robot is very helpful, solving all the little problems that come with leaving pets alone. It cannot only look after your pets but also make them happy while you are away from home, letting them hear your voice even when you are on vacation. With it, you can travel with peace and don't need to worry about your pets. It's like having a pet sitter in your pocket, which is more convenient and always ready to help.
